steps.content: According to legend, there's a mighty city...

It stands in the middle of the storm, illuminating the endless night. It is a beacon, a torch, it guards the rarest treasure in the world all alone. It embraces the most precious miracle in the darkness...
Do you know what it is?
It's happiness!

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Ta-da... I am Serpent, the circus performer of dreams. My greatest joy is bringing joy to everyone.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: You there! The frowning gentleman in the audience! Yes, you!
steps.female_content: You there! The frowning lady in the audience! Yes, you!

steps.speaker: Choice
options: I don't have time for this.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: That's right! Serpent invites you onstage!

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Aww, don't be such a killjoy! Serpent invites you onstage!
Your body somehow turns into a small wooden cutout, and is placed onstage.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Ah, much better! Your previous look was much too heavy!
She jabs you between your brows, making your wooden body shudder violently.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Relax, relax... Like I said, I want to bring joy to everyone. That includes you, of course.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Poor little dear. You can't taste the sweet Ambrosia and enter a sweet dream of your own, so you rack your brain all day to try to ruin my performance. I really pity you.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: So I've decided to give you a custom package of joy! Tell me, what do you want? I'll satisfy you personally!
You can't feel your new strange and absurd body, but you do feel shock and fear. This is the first time that you, as an intruder from reality, have been completely transformed by dreams.
The blue-haired girl in front of you wields greater control in the Realm of Dreams than anyone else. She can turn you into a ridiculous wooden cutout or kill you at any time.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I know you use Ambrosia to filter consciousness, and expel all the darkness and misery. Your goal isn't to create a new strain of Mania, right? Those contaminants are just garbage you don't want.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You spread Ambrosia to attain high-purity <color=#fb9259>joy</color> from the Sleepwalkers, who are immersed in happiness. You are definitely involved with the <color=#fb9259>Marv case</color>.
Such a highly-concentrated, singularly strong emotion reminds you of that horrible phenomenon. It's a possibility you have to consider. No one can bear the consequences...

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Are you trying to test the power of the <color=#fb9259>Black Ring</color>?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: And even use it to lure Quinn to work with you?
Serpent's wooden cutout rolls her eyes.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: You like Marv? You like the Black Ring?

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Then why are you talking about it? I was asking you about happy things, and you keep bringing up depressing things. You've always been like this!

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Stop being such a killjoy. You'll get beaten up sooner or later. Didn't you see the inspector's fists clenching angrily just now?
She still had the nerve to mention that.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: I was bringing him happiness. True happiness.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: You took away his freedom with a false dream.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Pffft... Here we go again. I know you are the "best" talker.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: "Roulecca, this place can only mimic your past, but it can't create your future. This isn't your life. Come back to reality, blah blah blah."

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: "Mess, this isn't the enemy you want. It devalues   your fight's worth. You can't forge a truly powerful Sacred Sword here. Come back to reality, blah blah blah."

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: "Eirene, this only gives you the illusion of a mighty foe. It can't produce anything other than your own reflection. Opponents who can truly surpass you are in the vaster, real world, blah blah blah."

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: "Dreams are just cages for all your consciousness, trapping you guys in narrow fantasies and depriving you of greater possibilities. Come back to reality... Come back!"

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Ha. With just a few words, you lure people out of the beautiful dreams I crafted for them. You encourage them to discard their happiness and return to their worst miseries... Aren't you the most bewitching little trickster?
She gazes at you, somewhat displeased.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: I gave them freedom, and let them decide for themselves what dreams they want the most. I enabled them to grasp onto their own happiness.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: I gave them the truest, healthiest, and most long-lasting happiness. Hey, they don't even have to worry about pain or hunger in their dreams!

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: If you hadn't come to ruin things, everyone would be dreaming forever. They wouldn't have to worry about their happiness coming to an end like in reality.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: But Sleepwalkers keep releasing dangerous contamination.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: That can't be helped. How can people have true happiness without expelling their pain and suffering?

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: At least everyone is happy in their dreams.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What about the people in the real world? You just let the contamination harm them?
Your wooden cutout body creaks as you blurt out these words. This body doesn't seem to hide your emotions very well.
But Serpent doesn't get angry. Instead, she starts clapping.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Hahaha, I can finally see a bit of your heart. Even though it's just a bit, it's so adorable!
With a clap of her hands, the wooden cutout explodes into colorful smoke. The stage set dissolves into colorful ticker tape and disappears, revealing the huge empty stage behind.
The real Serpent is suspended mid-air on a hula hoop. Amidst the flying ribbons, the girl is all smiles. Strange picture frames float about beneath her dangling feet.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: You've been through a lot of pain too, and you still want to bring happiness to others. You strive hard for this goal, and want to protect their reality.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: I like you this way, but you're going in the wrong direction.
She points to the frames surrounding you.

You see that each frame holds the smiling face of someone who's dreaming. The staff of the Midsummer Night's Club, Eirene, the housekeeper, the secret agents of the 9th Agency, the investigation team, random citizens you've never met... and Doyle.

They are all murmuring quietly, black fluid flowing out of their mouths. You wonder what the contaminants will turn into once they reach the real world. What kind of damage will they cause? A chill goes down your spine.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: See? They spit out so much black goo because there's too much suffering in the real world. That's why I help them purge all misery, and create dreams filled with only happiness.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Don't worry about the real world. I will invite everyone into dreams so that no one gets hurt ever again.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: By then, what does it matter what becomes of the real world? The real world created all the black goo of misery to begin with!

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: I want to rescue everyone from the real world, and go to a joyous paradise together. That includes you, dreamless one. I want to give you happiness, too.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: The happiness of you all... is my happiness!

Serpent flips over, jumps off the hoop and lands on the ground, then bows to you. She looks at you with a smile, just like when you first met. Is that so-called happiness flowing from the depths of her serpentine eyes?
Is this girl tricking you again? Or is she stalling for time?

The Sinners may already be struggling in battle. As for those in the frames, the mental states of all the Sleepwalkers are under threat. You can't imagine how much the contamination in District 14 has spread during this dreamtime.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: How are you connected to Marv's case?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I know about the Marv case from years ago. People immersed themselves in beautiful dreams, but their spirits became absorbed and destroyed. Ultimately, they became Corruptors. This is the truth about Ambrosia.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Pfff, that was so many years ago. Not important.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: There weren't that many victims back then, but things are different now. Have you been hiding all this time just to pull off today's large-scale mutation? I will stop you.

You wield the wooden cutout body and try to throw yourself into the only picture frame not spewing black goo at the center of the stage. The wooden cutout spins quickly, making you dizzy, but you manage to achieve your goal before she can react...

The wooden cutout spins into the picture. In an instant, your body automatically recovers. You bear with the dizziness and grab the person in the picture. It turns out to be a little girl with blue hair.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Hey! Not now! I'm not ready yet!
She struggles, trying to go back deeper. You hold onto her as tightly as you can, and you both fall into the depths of the picture.
Immediately, chaotic murmurs seep into the depths of your consciousness.

steps.speaker: Chaotic Voices
steps.content: Coming coming coming coming...

steps.speaker: Chaotic Voices
steps.content: Joy, give me joy, give me all your joy!!
A burst of nauseatingly sweet scale dust seeps into your nose. Something has wrapped around your body!
